reason: I have only ever hired builders through people I know, and I would still ask my friends for a crew before I pay a platform to pick one for me. A standard brief sounds useful, but I do not know who runs this or what happens to my money if the work goes wrong.
objection: Who stands behind these builders, and if the flat comes out badly, who do I call and who holds my money in the meantime?
would_change_my_mind: A builder I already trust, or a friend who has used it, recommends the platform and shows me a finished flat it handled, with the payment held until I sign off the work.
